review.attributesInfo: Measures how much a feature varies across stores. It is the standard deviation divided by the mean. A higher value means the feature separates stores better, so it is more useful for clustering.
review.attributesSubtitle: Performance, Product Attributes, Location Attributes — Deselect any that don't apply. Pre-ticked attributes are significant for this scope.
review.cutoffBanner: Lost Sales excluded — its score is under the 0.40 significance cutoff, so it barely separates your stores.
review.noDataBanner: Colour excluded — it has no data for this entire category.
review.attributePicksSubtitle: Attribute variants the agent will try. Keep the ones that suit you, remove the rest, or add a custom variant.
review.aiStripInsight: Accessories is furthest ahead of plan (76% vs 65%). Outerwear is furthest behind (55% vs 62%). Reallocate open-to-buy from Outerwear toward Accessories before the next commit window — the gap between the two is the clearest signal in this season.
review.customVariantFallbackSummary: We generated 4 clustering options from 7 pre-selected attributes (4 product, 3 performance). Safe keeps all product attributes plus performance attributes scoring 0.5 or below. Aggressive keeps all performance attributes plus product attributes scoring 0.5 or below. Balanced keeps all product attributes plus performance attributes scoring above 0.5. Estimated fit ranges from 20% to 79%, with Safe the highest, and recommended clusters range from 3 to 7. Click to explore these options in chat.
